goal: Diagnose and reduce erroneous RNA-detected macrophage coefficients while retaining dose recovery; no claim of a new validated biological PGAM5-positive subtype
constraints: Preserve v6 identities, PGAM5 raw>0 labels, zeros and cycling cells. No patient-paired DE, depth matching/regression or survival reanalysis. GSE154906 remains cancelled
selection: All four fixed configurations reported; no selecting parameters based on outer held-cohort performance
background_prototypes: Within each original non-target fine group, training donor profiles with>=20 cells, >=6 supported donor profiles in total. Weighted KMeans on log1p(profile / saved v6 row-scale), k=min(3,floor(nprofiles/3)); weights equal-cohort then equal-donor. Add a centroid only if >=2 donor labels and >=50 cells; keep full baseline competitors and target components. Exclude every RNA-detected macrophage fine group from prototypes. Profiles are nuisance references, not new biological subtypes
feature_space: Same training-only v6 feature list and row scales for all four configurations; no held-expression feature selection. PGAM5 remains included
PGAM5_budget: Require the total predicted PGAM5 signal from ALL components to be <= the observed PGAM5 signal in the identically normalized mixture. An accounting constraint under reference/platform assumptions, not a biological calibration. If observed PGAM5 is zero, solve only over zero-PGAM5 reference components
solver: robust nonnegative simplex QP, same ridge0.001 and3 Cauchy reweightings as v6; add budget linear constraint only in the guarded variants
validation: Same v5 actual mixtures and v6 original RNA-detection truths; five whole-cohort holds, two units; inspect all zero-target stress cases, standard dose recovery, low-dose sensitivity, total-macrophage recovery and residual tradeoffs. v6 state evidence remains failed
interpretation: Even computational improvement does not replace independent protein/RNA identity, real-mixture or platform/cell-RNA calibration. Failed or unverified gates are not passed. Outputs remain exploratory coefficients
